summary_en: The caller initially asked about visiting-card pricing and minimum order quantity, comparing standard and matte finishes. The agent quoted ₹200 for 100 standard cards and ₹350 for 100 matte-finish cards, with a 100-card minimum and the option to increase the quantity. The caller selected matte finish and asked about design approval, delivery timing, and rush charges. The agent explained that delivery in Vijayawada takes three working days after artwork approval, while 24-hour delivery costs an additional ₹150. The caller said the design would be sent later and also asked about wedding-invitation pricing and payment conditions. The agent said wedding-card pricing depends on design, paper sample, and quantity; orders above ₹1,000 require 50% advance, while smaller orders are cash on delivery. The caller then stated an intention to order 200 matte-finish cards, provided the name Ramesh and email ramesh.audit@example.invalid, and requested an internal order request or quote. The agent confirmed that the inquiry, quantity, and email were noted and said the team would review and contact the caller. The call ended politely, but the transcript does not confirm that the internal order request or quote was actually submitted, so follow-up is required.
next_action: Review and submit the internal order request or prepare a quote for 200 matte-finish visiting cards, then contact Ramesh at ramesh.audit@example.invalid. Obtain the design when provided and confirm final pricing, payment, and delivery details.
